content: Dawita Wursetha Haasaya
Haysi Dawiti wursetha haasaya.

content.text: Tuma ta keetha asay Xoossa sinthan suure;
ha caaqoy giigidi, minnidinne naagetidi de7ees.
ta amotidaba ubbaa I tuma polana.
kushen shiishanaw hanonna agunthada wora holetana.
wale woyko xam7a ba kushen oykanaw koshshees;
hessi ba de7iya bessan eexana” yaagis.

content: Dawitara De7iya Mino Asata
Mino Dawita asata sunthay haysafe kaallidi de7eyisata. Koyroy, Takmoona yeleta gidida Yoseeb-Bestibeete geetetees; I heedzata halaqa; issi toho olan ba tooran hospun xeetu asi wodhis.
Heedzatape issoy, iya kaalliya nam7anthoy, Ahoha sheeshi gidida Dodo na7aa Alaazara. Issi gallas inne Dawiti olas shiiqida Filisxeemeta mandidosona; Isra7eele asay guye simmis.

Shin I ba bessan minni eqidi, iya kushey argaacidi mashshaara oyketana gakanaw Filisxeemeta shocis. He gallas Goday gita xoono immis. Olay eqin, olanchoti Alaazarako simmidi yidosona; shin enti hayqida Filisxeemetape ola ma7o qaaridosonape attishin, haraba oothibookona.
Iyape kaalley qassi Arooda yeleta gidida Aga na7aa Saama. Issi gallas Filisxeemeti misirey kumida shooqan, Leehi geetetiya bessan shiiqin, Isra7eeleti enta sinthafe baqatidosona.
Shin Saami shooqa giddon murti eqidi oletis. Filisxeemeta wodhis; he gallas Goday wolqaama xoono immis.
Katha caka wode hastamu mino asatape heedzati Adulaama gongoluwa Dawitako bidosona. He wode Filisxeeme olanchoti Raafayme zangaaran dunkaanidosona.
He wode Dawiti miixan de7ees; Filisxeeme olanchota cugay qassi Beetelemen olla kambe de7ees.
Dawiti haathe uyanaw amotidi, “Beeteleme katamaa pengiya matan de7iya olape haathe tana oone ushshanay” yaagis.
Ha heedzu mino asati Filisxeeme olanchota gutaa kanthidi, Beeteleme katama pengen de7iya ollafe haathe duuqidi Dawitas ehidosona. Shin I uyonna ixidi, Godaa sinthan tigidi,
“Abeeti Godaw, haysa uyanaysi taape haako! Ha haatha banta shempuwa bayzidi ehida asata suuthu gidennee?” yaagidi uyonna ixis. Ha heedzu mino asati haysa oothidosona.
Xaruya na7aa Iyo7aaba ishay Abisi hastamata halaqa; I heedzu xeetu asata ba tooran olidi wodhis; ika heedzatada eretis.
I hastamatape aadhidi bonchetida asi; I heedzata mela eretida asi gidonna ixikoka hastamatas halaqa.
Qabxi7eela yeleta gidida Yoodahe na7ay Banayasi mino ooso oothida gita asi. I nam7u eretida Moo7abe asata wodhis. Issi wode shachi wodhiya gallas ollan wodhidi gaammo wodhis.
Qassi issi gita Gibxe addiya wodhis; Gibxe addey toora oykis; shin I xam7a oykidi iyako bidi, iya kushepe toora dafi ekidi, iya toorara iya wodhis.
Yoodahe na7ay Banayasi haysa oothis; iya sunthay heedzataysada eretis.
I hastamata giddon daro bonchetida asi, shin I heedzata taybuwan deenna. Dawiti iya bana naagiya wotaadaretas tora mocona oothis.
He hastamata giddon de7eysati, Iyo7aaba ishaa Asaheela, Beeteleme yeleta gidida Dooda na7aa Eliyaana,
Arooda yeleta gidida Saamanne Eliqa,
Falxa yara gidida Selesa, Taqoha addiya Esika na7aa Irasa,
Anatoote yeleta gidida Abi7ezera, Kuussa yeleta gidida Mabunaya,
Ahoha yara gidida Xalmoona,
Naxoofa yeleta gidida Mahirayanne Ba7ana na7aa Heleba. Biniyaame biittan, Gib7a yeleta gidida Ribaaya na7aa Itaya,
Phir7atoona yeleta gidida Banaya, Ga7aasa zangaara matape yida Hidaya,
Araba yeleta gidida Abalboona, Barhuuma addiya Azmoota,
Sha7alboona yeleta gidida Eliyaaba, Asana nayta, Yoonataana,
Arooda yeleta gidida Saamanne Shaara na7aa Ahi7aama,
Ma7ika yeleta gidida Ahasbaya na7aa Elfalaxa, Gilo yeleta gidida Akxoofela na7aa Eli7aama,
Qarmeloosa yeleta gidida Hexira, Araba yeleta gidida Pa7aara,
Suubba yeleta gidida Naatana na7aa Yigi7aala, Gaade yeleta gidida Baana,
Amoone yeleta gidida Seleqa, Xaruya na7aa Iyo7aaba ola miishiya tookiya Ba7eroota yeleta gidida Nahiraya,
Yatira yara gidiya Irayanne Gareeba,
Hite addiya Ooriyoona. Enti kumethi hastamanne laapuna.
